records.key: Auto chose {winner}: highest macro-F1 on held-out folds ({split}), balanced accuracy breaking ties.
records.source: Auto chose {winner}: highest macro-F1 on held-out folds ({split}), balanced accuracy breaking ties.
records.translation: Auto가 {winner}을(를) 선택했습니다: 보류한 폴드에서 macro-F1이 가장 높았으며({split}), 동점이면 균형 정확도로 결정합니다.

records.key: Class {c}: {kept} assigned, {left} unassigned. All classes: {all_kept} assigned, {all_left} unassigned.
records.source: Class {c}: {kept} assigned, {left} unassigned. All classes: {all_kept} assigned, {all_left} unassigned.
records.translation: 클래스 {c}: 지정 {kept}개, 미지정 {left}개. 전체 클래스: 지정 {all_kept}개, 미지정 {all_left}개.

records.key: Classify every object from the labels made so far, then set a confidence threshold per class while looking at its objects. Auto classifier compares the classifiers on held-out wells and uses the best. Results go to annotate_classify beside the database; the labels are not changed. Default XGBoost.
records.source: Classify every object from the labels made so far, then set a confidence threshold per class while looking at its objects. Auto classifier compares the classifiers on held-out wells and uses the best. Results go to annotate_classify beside the database; the labels are not changed. Default XGBoost.
records.translation: 지금까지 단 레이블로 모든 객체를 분류한 뒤, 각 클래스의 객체를 보면서 클래스별 신뢰도 임계값을 정할 수 있습니다. 자동 분류기는 보류한 웰에서 분류기들을 비교해 가장 좋은 것을 사용합니다. 결과는 데이터베이스 옆 annotate_classify에 저장되며 레이블은 바뀌지 않습니다. 기본값 XGBoost.

records.key: Classify is off for a count column.
records.source: Classify is off for a count column.

records.key: Comparing classifiers on held-out wells, then classifying…
records.source: Comparing classifiers on held-out wells, then classifying…
records.translation: 보류한 웰에서 분류기를 비교한 뒤 분류하는 중…

records.key: Fit XGBoost on every label and classify every object.
records.source: Fit XGBoost on every label and classify every object.
records.translation: 모든 레이블로 XGBoost를 학습하고 모든 객체를 분류합니다.

records.key: Macro-F1: the F1 score (harmonic mean of precision and recall) of each class, averaged over the classes. Balanced accuracy: the recall of each class, averaged over the classes. Control rows: the largest class called for every object, and XGBoost fitted on shuffled labels; they cannot be chosen.
records.source: Macro-F1: the F1 score (harmonic mean of precision and recall) of each class, averaged over the classes. Balanced accuracy: the recall of each class, averaged over the classes. Control rows: the largest class called for every object, and XGBoost fitted on shuffled labels; they cannot be chosen.
records.translation: Macro-F1: 각 클래스의 F1 점수(정밀도와 재현율의 조화 평균)를 클래스에 걸쳐 평균한 값. 균형 정확도: 각 클래스의 재현율을 클래스에 걸쳐 평균한 값. 대조 행: 모든 객체를 가장 큰 클래스로 부르는 경우와, 섞은 레이블로 학습한 XGBoost이며 선택될 수 없습니다.

records.key: Open an experiment source before classifying.
records.source: Open an experiment source before classifying.

records.key: Score XGBoost, gradient boosting, LightGBM, random forest, extra trees and logistic regression (and ResNet50 features when a GPU is free) on held-out wells, with a majority-class and a shuffled-label control, and classify with the highest macro-F1.
records.source: Score XGBoost, gradient boosting, LightGBM, random forest, extra trees and logistic regression (and ResNet50 features when a GPU is free) on held-out wells, with a majority-class and a shuffled-label control, and classify with the highest macro-F1.
records.translation: 보류한 웰에서 XGBoost, 그래디언트 부스팅, LightGBM, 랜덤 포레스트, 엑스트라 트리, 로지스틱 회귀(GPU가 비어 있으면 ResNet50 특징도)를 다수 클래스 대조와 섞은 레이블 대조와 함께 평가하고, macro-F1이 가장 높은 것으로 분류합니다.

records.key: The lowest probability at which an object is called this class. Objects under it are left unassigned. Default 0.00, which keeps every object.
records.source: The lowest probability at which an object is called this class. Objects under it are left unassigned. Default 0.00, which keeps every object.
records.translation: 객체가 이 클래스로 불리는 가장 낮은 확률입니다. 그보다 낮은 객체는 미지정으로 남습니다. 기본값 0.00이며 모든 객체를 유지합니다.

records.key: Train ResNet50 on the crop images in the Classify screen, with this source and column filled in.
records.source: Train ResNet50 on the crop images in the Classify screen, with this source and column filled in.
records.translation: Classify 화면에서 크롭 이미지로 ResNet50을 학습합니다. 이 소스와 열이 미리 채워집니다.

records.key: Write these thresholds into the classification settings file and re-call the classification table from its stored probabilities. Rerunning the settings file gives the same table.
records.source: Write these thresholds into the classification settings file and re-call the classification table from its stored probabilities. Rerunning the settings file gives the same table.
records.translation: 이 임계값을 분류 설정 파일에 쓰고, 저장된 확률로 분류 표를 다시 지정합니다. 설정 파일을 다시 실행하면 같은 표가 나옵니다.

records.key: {n} objects classified with {model}. Each object is called its most likely class; it stays unassigned when that probability is under the class's threshold.
records.source: {n} objects classified with {model}. Each object is called its most likely class; it stays unassigned when that probability is under the class's threshold.
records.translation: 객체 {n}개를 {model}(으)로 분류했습니다. 각 객체는 가장 가능성 높은 클래스로 불리며, 그 확률이 클래스 임계값보다 낮으면 미지정으로 남습니다.
